{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Filter out QA and refunded orders
clean_sales = sales[(sales['revenue_float'] != 999999.99) & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]
print(f"Number of valid completed orders after cleaning: {len(clean_sales)}")

# Calculate total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = clean_sales.groupby('channel')['revenue_float'].sum()
print("Total revenue by channel (after cleaning):")
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the most revenue
most_revenue_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
most_revenue_value = revenue_by_channel.max()
print(f"Channel with most revenue: {most_revenue_channel} ({most_revenue_value:,.2f})")"}
